title: Release Manifest
description: Schema for clients/release.json — the single version source of truth for all three client platforms.

schema.description: Schema version of this release manifest.

versionName.description: Semantic version string shared across all three platforms.

buildNumber.description: Monotonically increasing build number. Android versionCode, iOS CFBundleVersion, HarmonyOS versionCode must all equal this.

protocolVersion.description: Wire protocol version. It is 1 because nothing precedes this protocol: there is no earlier version to stay compatible with. It is not negotiated — a client either speaks this protocol or it is paired again with a fresh invitation.

ios.description: Minimum iOS version (e.g. '17.0'). Determined after compile-time API availability verification.

harmonyApi.description: Minimum HarmonyOS API level. Determined after compile-time API probe verification.
